jobs.occupation: Hays - Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and performance of IT services delivered by external suppliers. Working in an international multi-vendor environment, you will monitor service delivery, challenge vendors and drive structural improvements across IT services.
Your main responsibilities include

• Leading regular supplier service reviews and contributing to quarterly business reviews.

• Monitoring SLAs, service performance, breaches and supplier actions.

• Challenging vendors on performance, root-cause analyses and recurring service issues.

• Identifying opportunities for structural and continuous service improvement.

• Coordinating issues involving multiple IT suppliers and driving them towards resolution.

• Maintaining the SLA framework, service catalogue, vendor register and renewal calendar.

• Validating supplier invoices, cloud consumption and software licensing against contractual scope.

• Supporting contract renewals and amendments.

• Coordinating service transitions when IT services move between suppliers.

• Contributing to service reporting and overall supplier governance.

What you'll get in return

In return for your expertise, you will receive an attractive salary package including

• Gross monthly salary between EUR5,000 and EUR6,100.

• Company car

• Group and hospitalization insurance

• EUR125 NET/month allowance

• Meal vouchers of EUR8 per worked day and EUR250 eco vouchers per reference year

• Bonus potential of 10% of the annual gross salary, subject to the applicable bonus plan

• Laptop and mobile phone/subscription

• 26 holidays

• A 39-hour working week with flexible working hours and time registration

• After the first three months of office-based onboarding, two teleworking days per week, with fixed days agreed with the supervisor. Teleworking from abroad is not possible.

You combine solid experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery and Vendor Management with a good technical understanding of infrastructure and cloud environments.

• You have at least 10 years of relevant IT experience, ideally within outsourced or multi-vendor environments.

• You have experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery, Service Integration, Vendor Management and/or Supplier Governance.

• You have a strong understanding of infrastructure, cloud and security, allowing you to challenge external IT suppliers.

• Experience working with offshore, nearshore and multi-vendor environments is an advantage.

• You are comfortable leading service review meetings involving multiple external suppliers.

• You communicate clearly and diplomatically with technical, business and external stakeholders.

• You are structured, proactive, solution-oriented and able to challenge vendors constructively.

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an advantage.

• You have a relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please contact Alexia Brosens from Hays or click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

jobs.occupation: Randstad Digital - Project Manager - Cloud & HPC
jobs.description:
• Define and manage the integrated project plan, including scope, deliverables, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, quality and acceptance criteria

• Lead projects involving cloud services, HPC platforms, secure compute environments, infrastructure modernization, integrations and migration.

• Act as the central coordination point for business and research stakeholders, ICT teams, architects, security, procurement, operational teams and external partners.

• Coordinate agreement on service ownership, support responsibilities, acceptance criteria and the operational model. 

• Master's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Proven experience managing complex cloud, infrastructure, platform, DataCenter or HPC-related projects - mandatory (8+ years)

• Ability to translate between business or research needs and technical, security and operational realities.

• Understanding of cloud, HPC, infrastructure and secure environments to coordinate specialists, challenge plans and identify delivery risks.

• Experience with cloud adoption, platform modernization, compute-intensive or highly secure environments is an advantage (8+ years)

You will join a Belgian IT department of approximately 30 professionals who work closely with colleagues and external partners across multiple countries. The environment includes a mix of modern and legacy systems, requiring a pragmatic and adaptable approach to technology and architecture. The company values collaboration, knowledge sharing and sustainable growth while maintaining a strong focus on work-life balance.
Your new role

As a Solution Architect, you play a key role in translating business needs into scalable and secure technology solutions. You work closely with business stakeholders, analysts, developers and architects to define the technical direction of projects and ensure successful implementation.

Your responsibilities include:

• Translating business and IT requirements into end-to-end solution designs

• Creating and documenting architecture and technical designs

• Defining the technologies, integration patterns and architectural standards to be applied

• Analysing how different applications and platforms interact within the organisation

• Supporting the evolution of complex application landscapes

• Ensuring security, quality and architectural consistency across solutions

• Collaborating with business stakeholders and IT teams in Belgium and abroad

• Guiding development teams and providing technical leadership

• Assisting in the resolution of complex technical challenges

• Promoting best practices related to software architecture, integration and application design

You will operate in an international environment where collaboration with both local and offshore teams is part of daily business.
What you'll get in return

You will join a stable international organisation that offers flexibility, autonomy and opportunities for professional growth.

The package includes:

• Gross monthly salary between EUR6.000 and EUR7.100 depending on experience

• Company car

• Meal vouchers (EUR8 per day, with employee contribution)

• Hospitalisation and group insurance

• 35-hour working week

• Flexible working hours

• Hybrid working possibilities and flexibility in organising your agenda

• Easily accessible office location by public transport

• Career development opportunities within an international environment

Training and certification opportunities can be discussed with the hiring manager depending on team priorities and development plans.

For this Solution Architect position, we are looking for an experienced IT professional who combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills.

You ideally have:

• Fluency in English, combined with French or Dutch

• At least 8 years of relevant IT experience

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience

• Solid experience with Java-based environments

• Strong knowledge of API architectures, REST APIs and Swagger/OpenAPI

• Experience with MicroServices architectures

• Knowledge of container platforms such as Kubernetes, OpenShift and Docker

• Understanding of authentication and security concepts, including OAuth2 and OpenID Connect

• Experience designing application and solution architectures

• The ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Experience in consultancy or large international organisations is considered a strong asset. Experience within the financial sector is welcomed but not required.
What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

Your mandate: execution, ownership and results 
You will personally lead the on-site execution of a major industrial project while overseeing several others, with individual projects worth several million euros. Your responsibility extends from site mobilisation and execution through handover and contractual and financial close-out.
 
This is neither a design-engineering position nor a remote project oversight role. You will be close to the work, teams, subcontractors and customers — while maintaining control of safety, quality, deadlines, budgets, margins and contractual commitments.
 Where you will make the difference  
• Deliver on site. Set execution priorities, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and subcontractors, resolve operational issues and ensure safe, high-quality delivery. 
• Protect project performance. Own budgets, forecasts, costs, cash flow and margins; spot deviations early and act before they affect results. 
• Manage contractual complexity. Anticipate risks, handle variations and claims, contribute to negotiations and safeguard customer relationships, including in public-sector projects. 
• Lead and develop people. Guide a team of approximately five to six project professionals, building accountability, confidence and stronger project practices. 
• Create clarity. Use practical planning, reporting and project reviews to turn complex situations into timely decisions — without unnecessary bureaucracy. 
 
• At least 7 years managing complex industrial projects, including substantial, hands-on responsibility for on-site execution. 
• At least 3 years in project management roles, with proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams. 
• Strong financial and contractual judgement: budgets, margins, forecasts, risk, negotiation and claims. 
• A sound technical foundation, ideally in mechanical, electromechanical, civil or industrial engineering; other educational backgrounds are welcome with substantial relevant experience. 
•  Fluent French and English; basic Dutch is an advantage. Experience with public procurement is particularly valuable.  
Above all, you enjoy the reality of industrial sites. You are pragmatic, structured and decisive; you can challenge technical choices, understand their commercial consequences and bring people with you.

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager - Hunter (Pharmaceutical Laboratory Services) - Europe
jobs.description:
Your mission: WIN NEW BUSINESS!      You will take ownership of new client acquisition in the European (bio)pharmaceutical market.    Your primary goal is to build a strong pipeline, engage decisionmakers and win new contracts for our    QC laboratory services.    You combine disciplined prospecting with consultative selling and confidently drive opportunities from first contact through negotiation and contract signature.
   
• Identify, target and acquire new customers in the European (bio)pharmaceutical sector, with a focus on companies developing and manufacturing small and/or large molecules.  
• Build and execute a proactive account acquisition plan, including cold outreach, networking, referrals, industry events and strategic partnerships.  
• Create and maintain a healthy, qualified sales pipeline and take full ownership of opportunities from lead generation to closing.  
• Lead negotiations, overcome objections and close profitable contracts in line with commercial targets.  
• Represent SGS Pharma laboratory services at conventions, exhibitions, professional associations and targeted networking events.  
• Maintain accurate CRM data, opportunity stages, next actions and forecasts. 

What do you need to be successful in this role?
   
• A bachelor's or master's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, life sciences or a related field.  
• At least 3 years of successful sales or business development experience in the pharmaceutical industry, ideally within laboratory, analytical, QC, CDMO/CRO or related services.  
• Good knowledge of regulatory QC requirements, including GMP and FDA expectations.  
• Consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills, combined with a strong focus on measurable commercial results.  
• You stay focused through long sales cycles and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.  
• An entrepreneurial and structured working style, with strong CRM discipline  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.    Additional European languages are an advantage.  
This is a position for someone who wants to have a real impact on business growth.    You will have the freedom to develop new markets and customers while being backed by experienced experts.
 
You can focus on building relationships, identifying opportunities and closing businesses, while working in a scientific environment where quality, expertise and reliability are key.

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

Do you have experience working with fabrics and know how to identify different pattern pieces? For a garment manufacturing company in the Tielt region, we are looking for someone to prepare fabrics for the cutting process and correctly sort the cut pattern pieces.

• You set up the machine and monitor the automatic unrolling and layering of the fabric.

• You take into account the fabric direction, warp and weft when preparing the materials

• You identify weaving defects and other irregularities and position the fabric in such a way that defective sections do not end up in the finished garments

• You check that the fabrics are correctly prepared and ready for the cutting machine.

• You collect the cut pieces and sort them according to the correct pattern.

• You group components such as sleeves, collars, front panels and back panels so they can be processed together in the next production stage.

• You follow the production schedule and ensure that the work progresses smoothly and efficiently.

 

• You have knowledge of fabrics and textiles, preferably gained through experience in a garment workshop or textile company.

• You can identify different garment components and pattern pieces.

• You can recognise fabric defects and know how to take them into account when laying out the fabric.

• You work accurately while maintaining a good production pace.

• You can count correctly and distinguish between colours, sizes and quantities.

• You have a sufficient understanding of Dutch to correctly interpret work instructions, numbers and labels. Knowledge of English is also an advantage.

• You are physically fit for the job and can work both independently and as part of a team.

• Sewing skills are not required. However, it is important that you can recognise fabrics and the different components of a garment.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.
